findings.description: At phone widths (600 px and below) the stylesheet hides the table header row (thead display:none) and turns rows and cells into blocks. The accessibility tree then exposes no columnheaders and no table structure, so screen-reader users hear amounts and categories with no Title/Category/Amount labels. The same applies to the editor view.
repro: Sign in as viewer-3cfd at a 360 px wide viewport.
Inspect the accessibility tree (for example with page.locator('main').ariaSnapshot()): the table has no columnheader nodes and each row is a bare cell list such as 'Train to Pune travel $42.50'.
Compare with a 1280 px viewport, where the four columnheaders are exposed.

findings.description: Every row has an Edit link and a Delete button with the same accessible name, so the list of actions gives no way to tell which expense each control acts on. Screen-reader users hearing 'Delete, Delete, Delete...' cannot choose the right row.
repro: Sign in as editor-1a1b at 1280 px.
Read the accessibility tree of the table: every Delete button is named 'Delete' and every link 'Edit', with no expense title in the name.

findings.description: A title with no spaces that is wider than the table column (for example a 130-character title) is not wrapped, so the table grows past the 960 px card and the whole page scrolls horizontally at 1280 px (document scrollWidth 1626 px against a 1280 px viewport). Long titles with spaces wrap correctly.
repro: Sign in as editor-1a1b at 1280 px.

Open /expenses/new and enter the title 'Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious_Conference_Travel_Reimbursement_For_Q3_Offsite_Workshop_Berlin_2026_Extra_Long_Title_Without_Spaces', category travel, amount 98765432.1, then Save.
The new row pushes the Actions column out of the card and the page gets a horizontal scrollbar.

findings.description: Amounts of $1,000 and above are shown without a thousands separator (for example '$1234.50' in the row and 'Total: $1634.49' in the total), while the rest of the money formatting is standard currency style. This reads as inconsistent number formatting in an expense report.
repro: Sign in as editor-1a1b and add an expense with amount 1234.5 (any category), then Save.
Look at the Amount cell: it shows '$1234.50' rather than '$1,234.50'.
Look at the total line: 'Total: $1634.49' with no separator.

notes: Tested at 1280, 360, 320-1920 widths for overflow, both roles, sign-in and wrong-password error, sign-out, category filter (totals checked against row sums for all three categories for both roles), add/edit/delete as editor (totals reconciled, test rows removed afterward), viewer access to /expenses/new and /expenses/:id/edit (403, correct), keyboard tab order and focus outlines, theme colour contrast (text, muted, danger, accent pairs all at or above 4.5:1; focus ring about 2.5:1 and input borders about 1.4:1 were not reported as they are design choices). Not tested: touch gestures beyond tap, screen reader audio output, the 768 px layout in depth, browser zoom at 200 percent beyond the overflow check, and non-Chromium browsers.

cost.notes: estimate from 56003 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0006-$0.0067
